faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting body for the Junior Research Fellow recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment process is conducted by the Kalsi Forest Division in Uttarakhand for filling up available research positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow post under this recruitment notification released by Kalsi Forest Division.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for Kalsi Forest Division Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to submit their applications through offline mode by sending the filled form to the designated address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the completed application form for the Junior Research Fellow post is 05-10-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Post Graduate Degree in Forestry, Botany, Zoology, Life Science, Environmental Science, or related disciplines along with a NET qualification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates appointed as Junior Research Fellow will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 37,000.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for candidates belonging to General, OBC, SC, or ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Kalsi Forest Division Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The selection of eligible candidates for the Junior Research Fellow post will be strictly based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be posted in Kalsi, Uttarakhand, under the jurisdiction of the Kalsi Forest Division.

faq.question: Q10. How can candidates download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: Candidates can download the official notification PDF and application form by visiting the important links section provided in this recruitment article.
